title: Day Six: Roar Doesn't Return (Ngày 6: Roar không về)
time_label: Sáng sớm, cửa hang và rừng già (12:00–13:00)

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Grandmother, Roar's bed is cold. He left before moonset.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: He went after the rhino, alone. Losing to the stranger burned him inside.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: A rhino can crush a man. He can't do this alone!

clips._hinh: Stream chạy ra cửa hang nơi Grandma Moon đứng nhìn rừng sương. Ổ lá của Roar trống, cây giáo mới không còn.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Grandma, let me find him. I have a whistle. Stream knows tracks.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Roar wants you gone. Why look for him?

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Hating me doesn't make him less one of us. Our people come home.

clips._hinh: Khang đã thắt dây giày, đeo ba lô cam, dao đa năng và còi lủng lẳng trước ngực. Grandma Moon nhìn anh dò xét.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Roar's footprints follow the rhino tracks. Here, broken twigs, leaves turned over. Not long ago.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: A whistle carries farther than shouting. Three blasts means help. If he hears it, he'll shout back.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Shh... listen. Down there.

clips._hinh: Trong rừng già, Stream cúi xem dấu chân, nhặt một cành gãy, lật một chiếc lá. Khang thổi còi ba tiếng, lắng nghe. Stream giơ tay ra hiệu im lặng.
clips.setting: Deep primeval jungle in the Stone Age in the morning: damp earth with fresh footprints, broken twigs, leaves turned pale side up, giant trunks and hanging lianas, shafts of light through the canopy.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Go away! I don't need pity! I can climb out myself!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: With your ankle that swollen? How? Sit still. Don't try to stand.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: I've been here since night. The tiger walked the edge twice.

clips._hinh: Từ mép hố sụt nhìn xuống: Roar ngồi tựa vách đá dưới đáy, cổ chân trái sưng tím, giáo nằm bên cạnh. Khang quỳ ở mép hố nhìn xuống.
clips.setting: A limestone sinkhole in the primeval jungle at midday: a pit about four meters deep with steep mossy rock walls, ferns and reeds hanging over the rim, a big tree right at the edge, a shaft of sunlight reaching the soft earthen bottom.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

location: Sương sớm trùm cửa hang; rừng già sau đó, đất ẩm in dấu chân, cành gãy, dây leo chằng chịt; cuối cảnh là mép một hố sụt đá vôi sâu chừng bốn mét, cỏ lau rủ xuống.
setting: Early misty morning at the mouth of the Stone Age clan cave: thick white mist over the jungle below, cool grey-blue light, an empty bed of dry leaves just inside the entrance.

title: The Sinkhole (Hố sụt)

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: One vine snaps. Braid three together and it'll hold a buffalo. Pull it tight for me!

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Where did you learn this? We braid baskets, never rope this thick.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: The internet. I mean... a place very far away.

clips._hinh: Khang và Stream giật những sợi dây leo dài từ thân cây. Khang bện ba sợi thành một sợi to, Stream giữ đầu kia kéo căng.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo trousers muddy at the knees, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Not broken, just twisted. I'll splint it. If it hurts, scream. No shame in that.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Hunters don't scream! A hunter screams, the animals run! Argh!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: There are no animals down here. Just you and me.

clips._hinh: Khang tụt dây xuống đáy hố, quỳ bên Roar, kẹp cổ chân anh giữa hai thanh gỗ rồi quấn chặt bằng chiếc khăn rằn đỏ. Roar nghiến răng, gân cổ nổi lên.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Why save me? I wanted you out of our cave.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Where I'm from, the village helps whoever falls. Kick me out once you're up.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Strange knot. Tight, but it doesn't squeeze. Who taught you?

clips._hinh: Khang luồn dây qua ngực Roar, thắt một nút ghế. Roar quay mặt đi, rồi cúi nhìn nút dây, sờ thử.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana
wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Pull! One, two, three! Around the tree, so he can't fall!

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: I'm up. From today, you are my brother. Whoever wants you gone, goes through me.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Then, Roar, stop calling me stranger, okay?

clips._hinh: Trên mép hố, Khang đã trèo lên, cùng Stream (cảnh quay riêng) kéo dây vòng qua gốc cây. Roar được kéo lên mép cỏ, nằm ngửa thở dốc, giơ tay nắm lấy tay Khang.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana
wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

location: Hố sụt đá vôi giữa rừng, ánh nắng rọi xiên xuống đáy; một gốc cây to ở mép hố.
setting: A limestone sinkhole in the primeval jungle at midday: a pit about four meters deep with steep mossy rock walls, ferns and reeds hanging over the rim, a big tree right at the edge, a shaft of sunlight reaching the soft earthen bottom.

title: Muddy Water (Nước đục)
time_label: Chiều ngày 6, bờ suối trên đường về (14:00–15:00)

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Wait. This morning the stream was clear. Why is it brown now?

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Rain upstream makes the water brown. Every season. Nothing to fear.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: It's sunny here. But look at those branches racing. The water's rising fast!

clips._hinh: Khang dìu Roar chống gậy đi dọc suối thì khựng lại, nhìn mặt nước: đục như nước cháo, một cành cây lớn lao vụt qua.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana
wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Look, black clouds all over the headwaters. Tonight all that water comes here.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Our cave sits by the stream. Can water reach our beds?

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Flash floods don't creep. It hits all at once and takes everything!

clips._hinh: Khang leo lên một tảng đá cao, chỉ về phía đầu nguồn: mây đen trùm kín. Stream leo theo, nhìn theo tay anh, mặt tái đi.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: When I was small, water once filled the lower cave. Some elders didn't make it.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Then we can't wait! Is there higher ground?

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: The upper cave, in the cliff. Stream, take Fire the short way!

clips._hinh: Roar chống gậy nhìn mây đen, mắt tối lại như nhớ chuyện cũ. Khang quay phắt sang anh.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana
wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: This way! Through the reeds, across the rocks, then the cave! Stay close!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: What if Grandma doesn't believe me? Back home, even the truth gets ignored.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Here is different. I believe you. Grandmother listens to me.

clips._hinh: Stream dẫn Khang chạy băng qua bãi lau, nhảy qua khe đá, lá quất vào mặt. Khang thở dốc chạy theo sau.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

location: Bờ suối chiều; nước đột ngột đục ngầu, cành lá trôi nhanh; xa xa trên đầu nguồn, mây đen đặc như mực trùm đỉnh núi, chớp loé không tiếng, trong khi trên đầu vẫn nắng.
setting: A jungle stream bank in the Stone Age in late afternoon: the water suddenly brown and fast, branches and leaves racing past, reed beds and big rocks along the bank, the sun still bright overhead while black clouds cover the distant headwater peaks.

title: Nobody Believes (Không ai tin)

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Grandma, we must move to the upper cave now! A flood is coming tonight!

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: The sky is clear. It is not the water season. Why frighten the cave?

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: The stream's brown and rising! I saw it myself!

clips._hinh: Khang và Stream lao vào hang, thở hồng hộc. Mọi người (quần chúng) ngừng ăn. Grandma Moon vẫn ngồi, chỉ ngẩng lên.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Climbing to the upper cave at night, children and elders fall.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Grandmother, Fire has never been wrong. Fire, boiled water, the fish trap!

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: If he's wrong, the cave climbs in the dark for a stranger.

clips._hinh: Người trong hang xì xào, mấy bà mẹ ôm con chặt hơn. Stream bước lên đứng ngang hàng với Khang (Khang ở hậu cảnh, mờ).

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: He is no stranger. He saved me from the pit, with the tiger circling. I trust him.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Roar? You hated him most.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Hate was yesterday. Muddy water is tonight. Grandmother, take the cave up!

clips._hinh: Roar khập khiễng bước vào cửa hang, chống gậy, cổ chân nẹp gỗ quấn khăn rằn đỏ. Cả hang im bặt. Roar dừng trước Grandma Moon.

wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Everyone! Children first. Snail, carry the fire tube. Don't let it die.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Tie each child to an adult! Stream and I go last!

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Fire-Maker. If no water comes, you leave at sunrise.

clips._hinh: Grandma Moon đứng dậy, trao ống tre giữ lửa vào tay Snail (cảnh quay riêng). Khang buộc dây leo nối từng đứa trẻ vào người lớn. Grandma Moon quay lại nhìn Khang.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

location: Hang dưới chiều muộn: cả hang đang nướng cá từ cái lờ, trẻ con chơi đùa, ánh nắng vàng hắt vào cửa hang, tiếng suối dưới chân hang đã to hơn.
setting: Late afternoon inside the large Stone Age clan cave: golden light through the wide arched mouth, the elephant-shaped stalactite, bare rock walls, the clan grilling fish over the hearth, the stream below the entrance now loud and brown.

title: Flood Night (Lũ đêm)

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Grandmother, one is missing! Where's Snail? Has anyone seen Snail?

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: The fire tube is gone too. He put it down to climb.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: He went back down for the fire. Since the night it died, he blames himself.

clips._hinh: Trên hang trên, Stream đi dọc hàng người, chạm vai từng đứa trẻ, đếm, mặt cắt không còn giọt máu. Grandma Moon nhìn chỗ đặt ống lửa: trống.

wardrobe.@Moon: a long dark hide cloak over a knee-length bark-cloth tunic, empty-handed with no bamboo tube, barefoot

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Found it! Still glowing! Little fire, this time I won't let you die!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Snail! Stay there, hold the stone pillar! I'm coming down! When I whistle, shout back!

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Fire! The water's up to my legs! I'm here!

clips._hinh: Cắt song song. Hang dưới: nước ngập đến đùi người lớn; Snail bám một cột đá, ôm chặt ống tre, than đỏ hắt lên mặt. Vách núi: Khang quấn dây leo quanh người, đèn đội đầu loé trong mưa, tụt xuống.
clips.setting: Night in the flooding lower Stone Age cave and the cliff face above it: brown water pouring in through the wide mouth and rising around stone pillars, the elephant-shaped stalactite, rain lashing the cliff where a vine rope hangs down from torchlight high above.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: The rope only reaches the big rock! Past that, I can't hold you!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Enough! Hold tight, back against the rock. Don't stand on that ankle!

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Fire! Bring the boy back. And bring yourself back too!

clips._hinh: Trên mép hang trên, Roar ngồi tựa lưng vào đá, chân nẹp duỗi thẳng, quấn dây quanh lưng để giữ. Dưới vách, Khang treo trên dây, ngước lên gào.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana
wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Snail! Your hand! Arms around my neck, don't let go!

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: The fire tube! I'm not letting go! Grandmother said don't let it die!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Fine, keep it! Onto that rock, quick, here comes the water!

clips._hinh: Khang lội vào cửa hang dưới, ánh đèn đầu tìm thấy Snail. Anh bế cậu bé lên vai; Snail vẫn ôm ống lửa. Hai người trèo lên tảng đá lớn ở chân vách đúng lúc một con sóng bùn tràn qua cửa hang bên dưới.
clips.setting: Night in the flooding lower Stone Age cave and the cliff face above it: brown water pouring in through the wide mouth and rising around stone pillars, the elephant-shaped stalactite, rain lashing the cliff where a vine rope hangs down from torchlight high above.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

location: Đêm mưa. Hang trên là một mái đá hẹp giữa vách núi, đuốc lập loè, cả hang chen chúc. Dưới chân vách, nước bùn gầm lên tràn bãi suối. Hang dưới tối om, nước đã vào đến lòng hang.
setting: Night during a flash flood in the Stone Age: a narrow ledge-cave high on a limestone cliff lit by flickering torches, heavy rain, and far below a roaring brown flood surging over the stream banks toward the mouth of the lower cave.

title: Three Million and One Boy (Ba triệu người và một thằng nhóc)

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Everyone! Down here! Two of us, both alive!

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Fire... the water's higher. Will the rock get swept away?

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: This rock is huge, the water can't move it. See the torches? Stream's throwing a rope.

clips._hinh: Khang ôm Snail trên đỉnh tảng đá, thổi còi ba tiếng, rồi rọi đèn đầu lên vách nơi những ngọn đuốc lập loè. Snail run rẩy, ống lửa ôm trước ngực.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Fire! The rope has a stone! Hands up and catch!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Got it! Tying Snail first. Bowline, it won't slip, don't worry!

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Snail, hug the fire tube! The whole cave is pulling! One, two, pull!

clips._hinh: Trên mép vách, Stream buộc một hòn đá vào đầu dây, quăng xuống; lần thứ hai Khang bắt được. Anh buộc Snail bằng nút ghế. Cả hang (quần chúng) kéo, Snail được kéo dần lên vách, vẫn ôm ống lửa.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: The strap snapped! No... all seven days are in there!

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Fire! Let the seeing stone go! Hold the rope with both hands!

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Go, then. Three million viewers aren't worth one boy holding a fire tube.

clips._hinh: Dây được thả xuống lần nữa. Khang với lấy dây thì khoá đai camera trên ngực bung ra; camera trượt khỏi người. Một tay anh vồ theo, tay kia bám dây. Anh dừng lại, buông camera, nắm dây bằng cả hai tay. Camera, đèn đỏ còn nhấp nháy, trôi vào màn mưa.

wardrobe.@Khang: dusty sweat-stained olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera, no bandana

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: The water came. The lower cave is flooded.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Is everyone here, Grandma? Did Snail keep the fire?

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: All here. The fire lives, the people live. You gave your stone for our fire.

clips._hinh: Khang được kéo lên mép hang trên, nằm vật ra, ướt sũng. Snail (cảnh quay riêng) mở nắp ống tre: than vẫn đỏ, cả hang thở phào. Grandma Moon quỳ xuống bên Khang.
clips.setting: Night during a flash flood in the Stone Age: a narrow ledge-cave high on a limestone cliff lit by flickering torches, heavy rain, and far below a roaring brown flood surging over the stream banks toward the mouth of the lower cave.

wardrobe.@Khang: dirty torn olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera
wardrobe.@Moon: a long dark hide cloak over a knee-length bark-cloth tunic, empty-handed with no bamboo tube, barefoot

location: Đỉnh tảng đá lớn ở chân vách, nước bùn cuồn cuộn quanh, mưa quất; phía trên, mép hang trên với đuốc và bóng người.
setting: Night at the foot of the limestone cliff during the flood: the flat top of a huge boulder just above churning brown water, rain lashing, torchlight from a ledge-cave high above, a vine rope hanging down the wet rock face.
